Frequently Asked Questions

Which mode should I choose?

Use Fast Mode for text documents (like resumes or essays) to keep them clear and selectable. Use Deep Mode for scanned documents, photos, or when Fast Mode doesn't reduce the file size enough.

Is it safe to compress my PDF here?

Yes. Unlike other websites, ToolsWaala uses 100% browser-side processing. Your files never leave your computer.

Portal File Size Guidelines for Indian Examinations

  • UPSC / SSC / State PSC Forms: Signature & photo PDFs must be strictly under 100KB.
  • NTA NEET / JEE Main / CUET Portals: Category certificates and class 10 marksheets capped at 200KB.
  • Naukri & LinkedIn Resume Uploads: Resume PDFs recommended under 500KB for fast ATS parsing.
